study_design: Prospective nested case-control analysis using prediagnostic blood samples within the Multiethnic Cohort
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Each of the 307 cases was individually matched to approximately 2 controls, for a total of 596 controls, on age, ethnicity, geographic location, date/time of specimen collection, and hours of fasting.
reason: Prediagnostic plasma CoQ10 was evaluated in relation to overall incident prostate cancer; no aggressive subtype was defined or analyzed in the abstract.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: We examined the association of circulating CoQ10 levels with prostate cancer risk, using prediagnostic blood samples.
estimate_classifications.reason: The supplied full-text estimate is for all incident prostate cancer cases, consistent with the abstract's overall prostate cancer endpoint; it is not an aggressive estimate.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
